# Mailshake

> > Mailshake is a sales engagement platform specializing in cold email outreach, multi-channel prospecting, and sales automation for B2B teams.

The platform provides tools for cold email campaigns, power dialing, CRM integrations (including Salesforce and HubSpot), and comprehensive educational resources through their Cold Email Academy, Practical Prospecting Podcast, and sales methodology guides. Founded by Sujan Patel, Mailshake helps sales teams automate outreach while maintaining personalization.

## Key Topics

- Cold email outreach and templates
- Sales prospecting and engagement
- Multi-channel sales automation
- Lead generation and qualification
- SPIN Selling methodology
- Sales enablement strategies
- Cold calling and power dialing
- B2B sales tactics
- Email personalization techniques
- CRM integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Copper)
- Sales discovery calls
- Outbound messaging strategies
- Email benchmarks and analytics
- Sales objection handling
- Practical Prospecting Podcast

## Cold Email Mastery

- [The Cold Email Masterclass by Mailshake](https://mailshake.com/blog/cold-email-success): Comprehensive masterclass on email lists, subject lines, and personalization
- [Cold Email Benchmarks 2026: The Complete Data-Backed Guide](https://mailshake.com/blog/cold-email-benchmarks-2026): 2026 industry benchmarks for cold email open, reply, and meeting rates
- [Module 3: Crafting Cold Emails That Convert](https://mailshake.com/blog/module-3-cold-emails-that-convert): Cold Email Academy module on 4-line framework for converting emails to meetings

## Sales Techniques and Methodologies

- [How to Overcome the 16 Most Common Sales Objections - 2025](https://mailshake.com/blog/sales-objections-2): Comprehensive guide to handling 16 most common sales objections in 2025
- [How to Execute a Sales Discovery Call + Questions to Ask](https://mailshake.com/blog/sales-discovery-call-questions): 7-step discovery call process for qualifying prospects and closing sales
- [Accelerate: SPINning sales outcomes](https://mailshake.com/blog/spinning-sales-outcomes): SPIN Selling methodology guide showing 17% improvement in sales outcomes
- [Mastering Complex Sales Negotiations](https://mailshake.com/blog/logrolling-negotiating-technique): Logrolling negotiation technique for resolving complex sales impasses
- [Maximizing Sales Advantage: The Power of Sales Battle Cards](https://mailshake.com/blog/sales-battle-cards): Guide to competitive intelligence using sales battle cards for enablement

## Outbound Prospecting Strategies

- [How to Book More Meetings with Cold Outreach](https://mailshake.com/blog/book-meetings-cold-outreach): Chris Ritson from Flexprts shares tricks for booking meetings via cold outreach
- [Qualifying Prospects: The Ultimate Guide](https://mailshake.com/blog/automate-list-building): Top 8 tools for automated list building and lead qualification strategies
- [Unlocking Outbound Messaging Success](https://mailshake.com/blog/offer-for-outbound-messaging): Practical Prospecting podcast on mastering offers in outbound messaging
- [The Permission Slap - Practical Prospecting Podcast](https://mailshake.com/blog/the-permission-slap): Practical Prospecting podcast episode on permission-based pitch strategies
- [Using Outbound Strategies to Get A Job](https://mailshake.com/blog/using-outbound-strategies): Jason Bay of Outbound Squad on using cold outreach for job search success
